fact: The Cour des comptes' 2025 annual report says the ministry's information system does not allow adequate monitoring of the epidemiological situation, that during the pandemic the ministry set up a health information system at the level of the wilaya health and population directorates through which users enter data into the central system at the ministry, and that executive decree 22-251 of 20 June 2022 created the Agence nationale de la numérisation en santé with the main task of setting up a national health information system.
title: التقرير السنوي 2025
